result.reason: The revision does not reach either playbook position. The cap remains based on fees paid for the particular services rather than the greater of 12 months’ paid/payable fees and $1,000,000, or even a clear 12-month-fees fallback. The carve-outs apply only to Contractor and therefore are not mutual; they also do not clearly cover both parties’ data protection/security obligations, indemnities, fraud, and infringement of the other party’s IP. It omits the required clarification that Company’s payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap. Although the indirect/consequential-damages exclusion remains mutual, the revision adds death, bodily injury, and property-damage carve-outs not required by the playbook and uses unexplained cross-references. Drafting issues include “COMPANYS’,” the awkward opening reference to “the foregoing,” and inconsistent scopes for the parties’ caps.
